_note: Story 10.2: who speaks in a .dialogue file. A line's speaker id is its character name lower-cased with spaces as _ ("Den Fa" -> den_fa), or a [#speaker=id] tag on the line (the Elder's lines say [#speaker=elder]). name: shown in the dialogue box. portrait: the dialogue portrait Story 25.17 paints (res://assets/characters/portraits/npc/<id>.png); while it is missing the box draws a plate in colour with the speaker's initials, or, for plate "mask", Den Fa's mirror mask (a pale featureless oval, never a face). quest_dealer is the staff role desk_manager in data/characters/staff.json. Add a speaker here before writing their first line.
